subject: Re: Discovery call recap - VPC/private options & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery call recap - VPC/private options & next steps

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through Acme's inference use cases. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

Call recap:
- Primary workloads: user-facing summarization (low-latency, 50-200QPS at peak) and nightly batch embeddings for search.
- Data policy: customer PII must stay in Acme network; prefer VPC or on-prem options for regulated product teams.
- Security asks: KMS integration, audit logs retention, SOC 2 evidence for our infra.

What I’ll send you (attached):
- redwood-vpc-overview.pdf — high-level VPC/private deployment flow and network requirements
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf — SOC 2 scope summary and what we can share with security teams

Suggested next steps:
1) Review the VPC overview and SOC2 summary with your security/network team.
2) Tell us your expected timeline and any gating items (procurement, security sign-off, budget).
3) If helpful, we can schedule a 30-minute technical deep dive with our solutions engineer next week to go over the KMS/network setup.

Open questions for you:
- Do you have a preferred cloud region or a specific VPC CIDR we should plan around?
- Any hard constraints on latency per request that we should prioritize in the architecture?

I’ve looped in Jonas (solutions) to help on the follow-up deep dive. If you’re ready, I can send a short mutual action plan to keep approvals on track.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood-vpc-overview.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

Just bumping this in case it got buried. Wanted to check if you had a sense of timing for the security review or whether we should set up the technical deep dive Jon mentioned.

Thanks —

Hi Aisha —

Following up again to check priority here. We’ve had a few conversations with teams like yours where the VPC path became a short pilot (1-2 weeks) to validate networking + KMS, which often helps unblock procurement. If you think that would help, we can offer a limited-phase pilot with a dedicated instance and assisted onboarding.

I’m attaching a short pricing worksheet and a one-page pilot plan to make it easier to share with procurement/security: redwood-private-pricing.xlsx.

Would you prefer:
- A quick 30-minute sync this week to align on next steps, or
- I can send a mutual action plan and proposed dates for a pilot so your team can review asynchronously.

If the priority has shifted, no worries — a quick note on timing would help us plan internally.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-private-pricing.xlsx (XLSX, 1 sheet)
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery call recap - VPC/private options & next steps

Hi Marissa / Jonas —

Apologies for the slow reply — we’ve been heads-down with a product launch this week. We’re definitely interested in the VPC/on-prem route for the PII-sensitive workloads, and the pilot idea sounds promising. Before we commit, our security and procurement teams have a couple of asks: 

1) Pricing detail for a 2-week pilot and monthly committed throughput pricing after pilot (we saw the worksheet you attached and will review, but can you provide a short line item summary?)
2) KMS options: do you support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS and bring-your-own-key?
3) Network diagram and port/IP requirements for whitelisting (our infra team needs specifics).

If you can send a 20-30 minute slot tomorrow or Wednesday afternoon, we can run through these asks with a couple of folks from security. Otherwise send the line-item summary and a proposed pilot MAP and we’ll review asynchronously.

Thanks —
Aisha Patel
Head of Platform Security | Acme Corp
aisha.patel@acmecorp.com
